title: Adiposity Measurement in Mice
author: Jon Ramsey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ybsfsne
materials: Body weight of animal is taken before anesthesia.

steps.title: Euthanize the mouse
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mouse according to the methods approved in the study’s IACUC protocol.

steps.title: Open the abdominal cavity
steps.instruction: Make a midline incision to open the abdominal cavity.

steps.title: Collect gonadal fat pads
steps.instruction: Remove the gonadal fat pads based on the sex of the mouse.

substeps.instruction: For males: Use forceps to pull up the epididymal fat pad, cut it just above the epididymis, and remove it.
For females: Cut the parametrial fat pad at the base of the uterus and separate it from the horn and ovary.

steps.title: Collect retroperitoneal fat pads
steps.instruction: Isolate and dissect the retroperitoneal and perirenal fat.

substeps.instruction: Pull the kidneys toward the midline to visualize the retroperitoneal fat pad.
Remove fat that extends past the lower pole of the kidney if it is not surrounding the kidney (perirenal), following the method of Johnson and Hirsch.
Remove the kidneys from the abdominal cavity and dissect the white fat surrounding each kidney.

steps.title: Collect mesenteric fat
steps.instruction: Use fingers to strip the mesenteric fat from the duodenum to the colon.

steps.title: Collect subcutaneous fat
steps.instruction: Skin the animal and carefully dissect any fat located between the muscle and skin.

steps.title: Collect intrascapular fat
steps.instruction: Dissect the adipose tissue in the intrascapular region.

substeps.instruction: Remove white adipose tissue covering the brown adipose tissue.
Dissect the brown adipose depot and clean it of visible white adipose tissue.

steps.title: Record and calculate fat weights
steps.instruction: Record the weight of each tissue and calculate total adiposity.

substeps.instruction: Record the weight of each tissue, combining left and right pad weights for total pad weight.
Calculate total white adipose tissue (WAT) by summing the weights of the gonadal (epididymal or parametrial), retroperitoneal (including perirenal), mesenteric, and subcutaneous depots.
Calculate % body fat by dividing the weight of fat tissue by the body weight of the animal.
